title: Balancing Optimality and Diversity: Human-Centered Decision Making through Generative Curation
abstract: arXiv:2409.11535v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many decision-support systems recommend actions by optimizing measurable objectives, even when a human decision-maker retains final authority and considers additional criteria that are difficult to specify in advance. We study how an algorithm should curate a small portfolio of quantitatively strong alternatives in such settings. We introduce generative curation, a framework that learns a recommendation policy to maximize the expected desirability of the action ultimately selected by the decision-maker. For policies that generate quantitatively competitive actions, we decompose expected portfolio desirability into quantitative performance and a qualitative curation gain. Under a Gaussian process model of residual desirability, this gain is characterized by the Gaussian width induced by the covariance kernel, yielding a decision-theoretic notion of diversity based on qualitative nonredundancy rather than generic geometric separation.

translated_title: 平衡最优性与多样性：通过生成式策展实现以人为本的决策
translated_abstract: 许多决策支持系统通过优化可衡量的目标来推荐行动，即使人类决策者保留最终决定权并考虑难以事先指定的附加标准。我们研究了在此类情境下，算法应如何策展一小部分定量上强的替代方案。我们引入了生成式策展框架，该框架学习推荐策略以最大化决策者最终选择行动的期望合意性。对于生成定量竞争性行动的策略，我们将期望组合合意性分解为定量性能和定性策展增益。在残差合意性的高斯过程模型下，该增益通过协方差核诱导的高斯宽度来表征，从而产生一种基于定性非冗余而非通用几何分离的决策理论多样性概念。
tldr: 本文提出生成式策展框架，通过分解期望合意性并利用高斯宽度度量定性非冗余，在定量最优与定性多样性之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a generative curation framework that balances quantitative optimality and qualitative diversity by decomposing expected desirability and using Gaussian width to measure qualitative nonredundancy.
